pages.title: Giant Forest Hog
pages.text: The giant forest hog ($(o)Hylochoerus meinertzhageni$()) is a wild pig native to the forests of West and Central Africa and parts of East Africa.$(br2)It is the largest living wild member of the pig family, covered in long, coarse black hair.$(br2)Giant forest hogs live in family groups called sounders, usually made up of a boar, several sows and their young. They were unknown to science until 1904.
